x: BELOW. Our winning Boys 4x100m team after the Surreys. Later in the season they went on to reduce the Club record to a fast 47.8. L to R; Bassam Zriek, Mark Dooley, Clive Gardne[illegible] and Gavin warr.

In summing up the season special mention must be made of the exploits of Gavin Warr (Youth) and Gareth Allison (Boy). Gavin competed in every Young Athletes League and won every race in which he competed.
Back Page; 15 yr old Gavin Warr improved his 200m p.b. to 23.6 and was our top points scorer along with Clive Gardner in the Dunlop Young Athletes League.

But pride of place must go to the Youths with Gavin Warr clocking a fine 23.1 in the 200m final and Glyn Tiernan breaking a 15 year old Championship Best Performance to win the Youths 1500m by a huge margin.
Mention must also be made of our Youths first choice sprint squad of Gavin Warr, Joe Minetti and Mark Dooley who competed whenever possible and were never beaten in the Young Athletes League sprints.

As usual we had a good blend of young (F.Ogwinda and Gavin Warr) and old (Stuart Paton!) with everyone producing creditable efforts. The one clang was down to one of our number who started to take his tracksuit off when the incoming runner was 60m away.
